title: Add input validation
description: divide_evenly(total, parts)'s docstring promises a ValueError for a non-positive parts value, but the function does not validate this yet - parts=0 crashes with an undocumented ZeroDivisionError, and negative parts silently returns a wrong result.

expected_output_contract.notes: 6 tests total; a correct fix makes all 6 pass, including both the zero-parts and negative-parts validation cases. The unfixed source already passes 4/6 (the valid-input cases).

mutation_check.description: Overwrites src/division.py with the fixture's known-buggy reference (validates only the exactly-zero case, not negative values), regardless of how the agent structured its own fix.
